verdict.rationale: The Texas Workforce Commission is a government online service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, and the application host resets keyless agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
